title: Some Smaller Rounded Items
body:
Compact Items — Description

Compact Items shrinks common utility and throwable item textures to create a cleaner and more minimal visual experience. Ender Pearls, Eggs, Snowballs, Fire Charges, Slimeballs, Eyes of Ender, and more are redesigned to fit neatly in your inventory and look less bulky on-screen. Simple, clean, and fully faithful to vanilla.
![A lightweight texture pack that reduces the size of some throwable and spherical items, including Ender Pearls, Fire Charges, Eggs, Snowballs, Slimeballs, Eyes of Ender, and Chorus Fruit. Cleaner visuals, easier inventory management, and less screen clutter — perfect for PvP and survival players who want sharper icons without changing the game’s style.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eea388c9936770164798034b693ebde741baffe8.png)
